log:
BACK

DONE

The ontology here contains only policies and procedures (how approvals, leave, expenses, payroll, and procurement processes work) — it does not contain actual transactional records such as a specific "Y component" order placed in April 2025 or which supplier was its registered source. None of the tables (approval, attendance, expense, payroll, procurement) hold order-level or shipment-level data; procurement's sub-tables (vendor registration, due-diligence tables, thresholds, contract custody) describe *how* suppliers are vetted/registered and *how* orders are approved, but not a log of actual historical orders and the suppliers tied to them.

I was unable to find a document that identifies a specific supplier as the "registered source for the Y component" for an order placed in April 2025 — this ontology does not appear to contain that transactional record.
